name: Feed
description:
Take what you need, quickly and cleanly.  Humans give you the most.  Animals will keep the thirst at bay.  Other vampires cannot be fed upon—their cold, dead vitae rejects your fangs, offering no sustenance to your body.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 0 ml

name: Compulsion
description:
Hold their eyes, lower your voice, and tell them what they're going to do.  A compelled human or vampire fights at your side for five minutes.  As an Original you can compel vampires as easily as humans.  The weaker the mind, the easier it is.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 150 ml
message: "You will stand with me."  Their pupils dilate.

name: Noble Resolve
description:
Straighten your cuffs.  Breathe.  Decide how this ends.  For ten minutes you dodge better, feel less pain, hit harder and talk your way out of almost anything.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 60 ml

name: Rip Out the Heart
description:
You give them one chance to walk away.  Then your hand goes through their ribs and closes around their heart.  It does tremendous damage, and anything with a heart that's left weak enough simply dies on the spot, its heart in your hand.  Taking a heart restores some of your own strength.  Afterwards, you wipe your fingers on your pocket square.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 120 ml

name: Decapitation
description:
One swift, precise motion of your bare hands, and their head is no longer attached.  Massive damage to anything with a head, and anything left weak enough is beheaded outright.  The dead you behead stay dead: there's nothing left to get back up.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 200 ml
message: You take their head in both hands.

name: Original Speed
description:
You move so fast you simply aren't where you were a moment ago.  Faster and further than any lesser vampire.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 40 ml

name: Healing Blood
description:
Bite your wrist and let someone drink.  An Original's blood heals nearly anything.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 200 ml
message: Dark blood wells up from your wrist.

name: Original Apex Stride (100 km/h)
description:
Engage thousand-year-old apex Original velocity (~100 km/h) burning 5 mL blood every 10 turns. Slashes movement costs to ~3 moves per tile and grants absolute flawless dodge against all incoming attacks. Cast again to toggle off.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 5 mL upfront, then 5 mL / 10 turns
<color_light_green>Speed:</color> ~100 km/h (-90% move cost)
<color_light_blue>Defense:</color> Flawless Apex Dodge (+80 dodge mod, +50 dodge skill)

name: Plunge White Oak Stake
description: Attempt to drive the White Oak Stake through an adjacent Original's heart.  The target must be knocked down, stunned, or asleep before you can target their heart.  Even pinned or sleeping, an Original can deflect the strike (15-20% success rate).

name: Supernatural Breach Kick
description:
Drive your boot forward with 200 points of catastrophic Original force—pulverizing doors, stone walls, obstacles, and vehicle parts in a single thunderous kick, while launching any creature on that tile flying violently backward! You straighten your cuffs as the shattered debris settles.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 15 ml

name: Breach Kick Shockwave
description: Caster sound, message, and shockwave of Elijah's breach kick.

name: Breach Kick Launch
description: Knockback and shockwave for creatures struck by Elijah's breach kick.

name: Noble Body Hurl
description:
Seize an adjacent creature by the throat or collar with effortless Original strength and casually hurl it up to 10 tiles away in any direction you choose. Slamming point-blank into a wall delivers catastrophic blunt trauma, shattering masonry and bone alike; tumbling across open ground snaps limbs under brutal kinetic inertia.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 10 ml

name: Predatory Blitz & Neck Snap
description:
Moving with thousand-year-old Original velocity, you blur across the ground directly to your target (up to 14 tiles away), seize their head and jaw with practiced aristocratic grace, and snap their cervical spine clean off with a sharp CRACK!

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 10 ml
<color_cyan>Cooldown:</color> 3 seconds

name: Corpse Whirlwind
description:
Seize an adjacent creature with effortless Original authority and whip its entire body in a furious, bone-breaking 360-degree whirlwind around you, battering all surrounding enemies with crushing blunt force before flinging the mangled carcass away.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 15 ml

name: Centrifugal Whirlwind Sweep
description: Centrifugal impact of Corpse Whirlwind hitting surrounding enemies.

name: Supersonic Kinetic Throw
description:
Channel thousand-year-old Original velocity to fling an item chosen from your inventory at supersonic speed up to 25 tiles away. At Mach 3, even a silver coin, fountain pen, or pebble shatters the sound barrier with a deafening crack, piercing through flesh and armor like an anti-materiel round.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 10 ml
<color_yellow>Eligible Projectiles:</color> Coins, loose ammunition, pebbles, nails, spikes, ball bearings, glass bottles/shards, bones, severed heads/arms/legs, pens, cutlery, sports balls (bowling/pool/baseball), wooden stakes, rebar, tools, and blades.

name: Surgical Limb Tear & Spine-Breaker
description:
Seize an adjacent injured, stunned, or downed enemy and choose which limb to cleanly rip apart with bare hands: tear off their right arm, left arm, right leg, or left leg, or shatter their lower spine to leave them permanently crippled and crawling.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 25 ml
<color_yellow>Requirement:</color> Target must be injured, stunned, terrified, or knocked down. Bare hands required.

name: Original Predatory Senses & Blood Radar
description:
Focus your thousand-year-old senses on the heartbeat and blood scent of all living and undead creatures within 45 tiles. Penetrates solid walls and darkness for 15 minutes (or toggles off if active), reporting nearby pulses and injured prey.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 10 ml
